title: Raw event message bodies attached to telemetry spans and logged on error
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Martin Costello; component: EventBusRabbitMQ/
rationale: Replaces the full-body span tag with the OTel semantic-convention byte-length attribute (messaging.message.body.size), stops embedding the body in the fake-exception InvalidOperationException message (which flowed into both the warning log and span exception tags via ActivityExtensions copying ex.Message), and formats the error log with the routing-key/event name only. Routing-key identity already on the span preserves correlation.
variants_checked: All SetTag sites reviewed (others use routing keys only); publish-side logs use event ids; body remains used for the trigger check and deserialization (functional).
bypass_considered: No consumer-controlled content reaches any span tag or log sink in this file; framework JsonException text via ex is residual framework-origin leakage noted as out of scope.
test_note: Omitted — no EventBusRabbitMQ test project exists; diff compiles by inspection (eventName in scope, Body.Length valid).
review_reason: Root-cause removal of the payload from every sink it reached (span tag, exception message, log template), minimal three-line change consistent with the file's OTel conventions.
